verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is a tax-compliance API/platform; the evidence covers nexus tracking, tax calculation, filings, and an MCP server that helps developers write integration code — but nothing shows the product itself surfacing AI-generated insights or suggestions from a user's own tax/transaction data inside the product UI. The MCP server explicitly only reads docs/OpenAPI spec, not customer data, so it cannot generate data-driven insights.
